headline: Industrias Michelin's León Plant Mitigates Email Breach Causing Minor Logistics Slowdown
body: The León Mx2 facility of Industrias Michelin, noted for its strategic role in the rubber sector, successfully managed a business email compromise incident. While the breach impacted order-entry and shipping alert systems, no core plant operations were encrypted, allowing for a swift recovery. Brief shipping delays were noted but resolution is underway. In light of this event, both Honda and Pacific Engineering Corporation (PEC) reported similar minor interruptions, suggesting an industry-wide vigilance. All companies assure stakeholders that logistical hiccups are temporary and under control.
